<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" agent="Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/155.0.0.0 Safari/537.36" pages="2" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="Pagina-1" id="O7WGsR-zxGDSt971hwVr"> <mxGraphModel dx="1084" dy="555" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> <diagram id="eWJuKYUJ4XB52xqme7gg" name="Pagina-2"> <mxGraphModel dx="5305" dy="2291" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "sequenceDiagram
 autonumber
 actor C as Client
 participant R as Router (Express)
 participant A as authMiddleware
 participant MC as MatchController
 participant MD as MatchDao
 participant M as Match (model)
 participant UD as UserDao
 participant VD as MoveDao
 participant EH as errorHandler

 C->>R: POST /api/matches/move<br/>Authorization: Bearer JWT<br/>{ shot, idMatch }
 R->>A: authMiddleware(req, res, next)

 alt token mancante o non valido
 A->>EH: throw UNAUTHORIZED
 EH-->>C: 401 { error }
 else token valido
 A->>A: jwt.verify, res.locals.user = { id, email, admin }
 A->>MC: next() → move(req, res)

 MC->>MC: validazione idMatch e shot
 MC->>MD: findById(idMatch)
 MD-->>MC: match | null

 alt dati non validi / partita inesistente / terminata / non è il tuo turno / fuori griglia
 MC->>EH: throw BAD_REQUEST / NOT_FOUND / FORBIDDEN
 EH-->>C: 400 / 404 / 403 { error }
 else controlli superati
 MC->>UD: findById(playerId)
 UD-->>MC: utente

 MC->>M: shot(shot, playerId)
 M->>M: aggiorna griglia, controlla affondamento e vittoria, changeTurn
 M-->>MC: esito

 MC->>MD: save(match)
 MC->>VD: save(mossa giocatore)
 MC->>UD: removeToken(COSTO_MOSSA), save(utente)

 opt partita contro il bot e ancora in corso
 MC->>M: shotBot()
 M->>M: sceglie una cella non colpita, shot(…, null)
 M-->>MC: [coordinate, esito]
 MC->>MD: save(match)
 MC->>VD: save(mossa bot, playerId = null)
 end

 MC-->>C: 200 { esito, … }
 end
 end",
 "config": null,
 "version": "12"
